exposure: affiliation to Colombian social security health insurance system
cohort: Live births in Colombia between 2005 and 2009.
finding: The low birth weight rate in Colombia was 8.6% on average between 2005 and 2009, and several maternal and infant factors were identified as predictors of low birth weight among full-term newborns.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with an increased odds of low birth weight (OR 1.49).
